title: Employers' Declarations on Modifications to Salary Terms for Work Permit Holders
what_it_is: Employers' Declarations on Modifications to Salary Terms for Work Permit Holders

sections.label: Work Permit salary declaration rules
sections.summary: Employers must declare Work Permit salary terms and may revise salary downwards with worker's written agreement and MOM notification.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: When applying for Work Permits (WPs), employers are required to declare key salary terms, including the basic and fixed monthly salary, offered to prospective Work Permit Holders (WPHs).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Employers are allowed to revise the salary downwards, provided they have obtained the worker’s written agreement and have notified the Ministry of Manpower (MOM).

sections.label: Salary reduction notifications 2019-2022
sections.summary: From 2019 to 2022, MOM was notified of salary reductions affecting about 3% of non-domestic Work Permit Holders yearly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: From 2019 to 2022, MOM was notified of salary reductions affecting an average of about 3% of non-domestic WPHs each year.

sections.label: Penalties for unauthorised salary reduction
sections.summary: Reducing salary without consent or before informing the Controller carries a fine up to $10,000 per worker; 27 employers yearly faced penalties.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: If the employer reduces the worker’s salary without their consent or does so before informing the Controller, they are liable to a fine of up to $10,000 per worker.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: From 2019 to 2022, administrative financial penalties were imposed on an average of 27 employers per year.

sections.label: Notifications not proof of violations
sections.summary: The 3% notification figure does not mean absolute violations, as administrative financial penalties were meted to 27 employers yearly from 2019 to 2022.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: For example, if the worker is underperforming and the employer rationalises the salary to be paid to a non-performing worker in lieu of retrenchment or firing the worker, which would have been the only other recourse that is left.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, I just want to make clear the point that the 3% notification does not mean that there has been absolute violations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: As I said in the later part of my reply, in the same time frame of 2019 to 2022, the administrative financial penalties were meted out to 27 employers per year.

sections.label: Justifiable reasons for salary variation
sections.summary: Depending on circumstances, there may be true, justifiable reasons to vary the amount of salary reduction or deduction paid to the worker.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Depending on the circumstances, there may well be true, justifiable reasons to vary the amount of salary reduction to be paid or to be deducted from the worker.
